title: Deeper/broader proxy spec-section correction and cross-peer evidence-boundary review
mode: Primary-source DWG specification re-read, peer-source triangulation, and local implementation-readiness update
scope: Verify the authoritative ODA section for DWG PROXY entity layout
Separate proxy custom entity data, typed object-ID references, and common proxy graphics
Reconcile current peer evidence with exact release, version, direction, and semantic scope
Refine the existing PAR-132/7CB implementation subplan without opening duplicate findings

method.kind: Read ODA v5.4.1 PDF sections and current primary project documentation/issues; inspect local parser, dispatch, and plan
method.limitations: No peer runtime, native CAD application, customer drawing, or DWG fixture was used. ODA section layout was reviewed from the locally available v5.4.1 PDF. The peer issue reports remain version- and sample-bound; no report establishes a libdxfrw defect.

sources.revision: v5.4.1 PDF; local text extraction verified sections on 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Section 20.4.90 is PROXY and defines versioned proxy metadata, databits, and typed object-ID handles. Chapter 29 is PROXY ENTITY GRAPHICS and defines its separate presence flag, byte count, and padded display data. Section 20.4.95 is SPATIAL_INDEX.
sources.limits: The spec provides layout and graphics encoding contracts, not custom vendor payload semantics or native consumer acceptance.

sources.revision: Merged commit c9cb845 reviewed 2026-10-18; follow-up PR status checked same date
sources.observed: The merged PR adds an opaque proxy-data retention route and reports a contributor corpus result. The follow-up is a separate Tianzheng payload interpretation path.
sources.limits: No corpus hashes or public regression file were included; reported counts are not independently reproduced. The R2010+ boundary technique is not a format rule, and the vendor-specific decoder is not general proxy semantics.

sources.project: GNU LibreDWG class maturity and release documentation
sources.revision: Class page identifies itself as LibreDWG 0.13.4; NEWS and 0.14.1 release page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The class manual distinguishes stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled classes and describes same-version raw-blob limits for some unknown types. Release documentation is a separate artifact/version identity.
sources.limits: Maturity labels and raw retention rules are LibreDWG implementation policy, not ODA rules or libdxfrw results. Do not pair the 0.13.4 class coverage page with 0.14.1 as though version-matched.

sources.project: ezdxf proxy entity contract and IxMilia.Dxf compatibility statement
sources.observed: ezdxf distinguishes original proxy data from saved display graphics and warns that exploding replaces proxy identity. IxMilia.Dxf states version/entity exclusions and warns that several output entity classes may not open in AutoCAD.
sources.limits: These are DXF implementation contracts and compatibility declarations, not DWG proxy semantics, execution results, or native CAD passes.

sources.limits: These reports do not establish local defects or file-format limits. The relevant local ownership already exists under identity, VERTEX, and parser-progress controls.
